_about: Per-ingredient decisions applied by scripts/add-looked-up-ingredients.py on top of the Morrisons lookup. cofid: use the CoFID food (raw, as bought) instead of a pack label that is 'as cooked' or was estimated. allergens: replace the looked-up list (conservative where the page gave no allergen text; verify against the pack). pack_size: costing weight (drained weight for tinned items).

orzo.approx: dried white pasta for orzo (the Morrisons page label is as cooked only)

couscous.approx: plain raw couscous (the Morrisons page label is as cooked only)

basmati.approx: white basmati easy cook raw (the Morrisons page label is as boiled only)

babycorn.approx: baby sweetcorn, boiled (the Morrisons page label macros are inconsistent; no raw entry in CoFID)

aubergine.approx: aubergine, boiled (CoFID has no raw entry; raw is about 15 kcal per 100 g)

edamame.approx: edamame, frozen, boiled (the Morrisons page label is as boiled)

seafoodmix.approx: cooked king prawns for a frozen seafood mix (the Morrisons page label is shallow fried; no mix in CoFID)

gnocchi.approx: pack label is as consumed; scaled to uncooked weight (no CoFID entry for gnocchi)
